digest.component_or_area: Code quality remediation (reconcilers, test fixtures, batch runner signatures)
propositions: AI-1 env-inheritance bug: when no_sync=False, subprocess inherits parent ambient REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off, silently suppressing live sync pull; both reconcile_helpers.py:_read_local_tickets and run_differs.py:_read_local_ticket_full require explicit env dict handling with conditional REBAR_SYNC_PULL setting and stripping on live path
Dead-copy _HAVE_ASTGREP capability flags in test_conformance.py and test_coverage_reconstruction.py are defined but never used in skipif (test_engine_b.py legitimately uses it and must be retained)
AI-3b: test_validation_depth.py needs a non-review (transform category) test to prove input-contract validation is category-agnostic

Tier-2 dead symbols must be removed after grep verification: _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, _PRIORITY_JIRA_TO_LOCAL, _TYPE_JIRA_TO_LOCAL, _SCRIPTS_DIR, _REFUTE_ELIGIBLE_KINDS, and fixture constants across test modules

BatchRunner.run signature must align across runners.py, code_review/batch_runner.py, DefaultBatchRunner, and CodeReviewBatchRunner to make agent_runner optional (mypy-consistent with ProductionBatchRunner)
